note: Mapped geometry triggers for field review, not an approval or a legal setback check. It looks only at mapped roads, buildings and footpaths (for tree-fall, clearance and access review) and does not assess wildlife: no forest-edge layer is mapped, and that would need an ecologist. Distances are from the edge of a simulated 30 m cell; the final tree position is unknown. OSM roads are centre lines, not kerbs. No mapped trigger does not establish safety. Utilities, overhead wires, sight lines, ownership, drainage and species/root clearances remain unknown until checked on site.
